title: CHEATING AUTOMATIC LLM BENCHMARKS: NULL MODELS ACHIEVE HIGH WIN RATES

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping the order of the target and reference models' outputs in the auto-annotator's evaluation template (Default vs. Swap) and measuring the change in the judge's preference and log probabilities.
Comparing raw win rates against length-controlled (LC) win rates on AlpacaEval 2.0 to account for the auto-annotator's tendency to favor longer text.
